methodology.selection: Read-only first practical sample; public YouTube metadata checked directly by video ID for title, channel, timestamp, duration >180 seconds, integer cumulative views, exact ID and non-live flags; relevance manually screened. Search results are convenience sampled, not market universe or ranking.
methodology.market: KR = Korea-localized Korean-language target, JP = Japanese-language audience target, US = English/US-localized and/or US-relevant target. Geography of creators and audience are not established, especially where search intentionally captures global English SaaS creators. JP-language results picked up by the US query were recoded JP.
methodology.windows: Cumulative calendar windows begin 2026-10-28, 2026-09-28 and 2025-11-27, each ending 2026-11-27 KST; live excluded. A row stores the smallest matching bucket; views are observed lifetime counts, not first-30-day views.
methodology.aiTopic: AI being a substantive subject or tool, independent of whether the actual upload uses AI.
methodology.aiProduction: Only specific producer disclosure in original YouTube description. Unknown is not evidence of no AI. VOICEVOX is labeled synthetic voice rather than all-AI. Topic demos/KDP AI product disclosures are not video-production labels. Scope/camera status otherwise limited; faceless candidates cannot establish rights, economics, or repeatability.
methodology.rights: Rights unknown for every retained row; public access, credits, original-content assertions, aid with AI or oEmbed do not establish permission to download, copy, dub, reproduce commercially or republish assets.
methodology.missing: D30 snapshots, monthly actual settlement, 3-month income, evergreen trends, same-age P25/median, verified operator independence and permissions were not available; upload activities or creative workflow metrics were not inferred from single videos.
methodology.secondPass: 199 additional candidates checked to the same source-date and duration rules; union checked against latest shared ledger 562 and the 2,883-row baseline before integration. No fresh fixed-window observation inferred.
